home.exampleNote: Indicative range from the current rule set. Change the inputs below for your own building.
home.estimatorTitle: Your building, your district, your finish.
home.estimatorHint: No account needed. Sign in only when you want to keep the result.
home.tryAsClient: Try it as a client first
home.classesTitle: One engine, five levels of certainty.
home.classesText: The same model powers a rough budget here and a tender BOQ in the professional workspace. The label tells you what the number is good for.

estimator.invalid: Choose a building type and a sensible size first.
estimator.noTypology: Pick what you want to build.
estimator.locationHelp: District price factors relative to the reference location
estimator.bedroomsHelp: Changing bedrooms suggests a floor area
estimator.levelNote: Level 1 · {{label}} · ±{{pct}} %. Numbers come from the estimate engine; the text parser only fills in your answers.

landing.parserNote: English, Kinyarwanda or French. The parser only fills in your answers; every cost comes from the engine.

wizardUi.gfaHelp: Gross floor area, all floors together.
wizardUi.elementsHint: Optional. Leave on default to use your overall finish level ({{quality}}).

budget.subtitle: Tell us what you can spend. We solve for the size and finish that fit, then re-check each option with the forward engine (within ±1 %).
budget.footnote: Most-likely cost ranges are ±15 % at this level. Choosing an option turns it into a forward estimate you can refine and save.

reach.subtitle: You own the land and have some money. See which construction stages your budget reaches and what the next step costs.
reach.reaches: Your budget reaches {{pct}} % of the build
reach.stagesNote: Stages are funded in construction order. Partial stages show the funded share.

complete.subtitle: Already building? Mark how far each phase has gone and what you have spent. We estimate the remaining cost, the forecast total and any shortfall.
complete.overspent: You have spent more than the estimated value of the work done so far. Check quantities, prices or unreported scope.

compare.emptyText: Open any estimate and press “{{compare}}” to add it here (up to 4).
